eligibility: B.Tech / MCA / M.Sc in Computer Science or related field with proven experience in full stack development.
description: Capgemini is seeking experienced Full Stack Developers to design and develop scalable web applications. Join our innovative team working on cutting-edge projects for global clients. You will be responsible for both front-end and back-end development, ensuring seamless integration and optimal performance. This role offers great opportunities to work with modern technologies and architectures.
responsibilities:
• Design and develop responsive web applications using React.js
• Build robust backend services and APIs using Node.js
• Work with MongoDB for database design and optimization
• Implement authentication, authorization, and security best practices
• Optimize applications for maximum speed and scalability
• Collaborate with UI/UX designers to implement intuitive interfaces
• Write unit tests and perform code reviews
• Deploy applications using modern DevOps practices
• Troubleshoot and debug production issues
• Mentor junior developers and share knowledge
• Participate in architectural discussions and technical planning
preferred_qualifications: Experience with TypeScript, knowledge of GraphQL, familiarity with microservices architecture, experience with AWS or Azure cloud services, understanding of Docker and Kubernetes, exposure to agile/scrum methodologies, contributions to open-source projects.
benefits:
• Competitive salary of 10 LPA with performance bonuses
• Comprehensive health and wellness benefits
• Flexible work arrangements and remote work options
• Annual learning and development budget
• Latest technology stack and tools
• International project exposure
• Sponsored certifications and training
• Employee stock options
• Collaborative and innovative work culture
• Modern office amenities and recreational facilities
